description: Create an automation rule: a trigger (record_created, record_updated, record_linked, schedule, webhook_received) + an optional condition + 1-10 actions (set_values, create_record, create_records, add_comment, notify_user, update_linked, send_slack_message, send_webhook, send_email, http_request, run_agent). A rule CAN REACH OUTSIDE STORYOS: it can send real email, call any public HTTP API and post to Slack, from scheduled and triggered rules alike. run_agent works an agent on a schedule or while nobody is signed in: for an agent on Your own AI, a wake queues and runs when an active, online Runner claims it (a wake nobody serves for 7 days is cancelled). A schedule every:"minutes" below 10 is refused. Covers every trigger and action shape, templates, top-N sort/limit. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES create_automation"]

actions.description: Array of 1–10 action objects. See also: get_started section "TOOL NOTES create_automation" for shapes. Each may carry its own optional `condition` (api_names).

approver.description: User id who approves this rule's require_approval actions (defaults to the rule owner).

condition.description: Optional filter AST (same shape as query_records) — the rule only runs on records that match. Not allowed on webhook_received.

database.description: Database name, api slug, or id (the rule's home database).

limit.description: Schedule-only top-N count, capped at 200. Rejected on any other trigger.

sort.description: Schedule-only top-N ordering — sort keys by field api_name, same shape as query_records' sorts. Rejected on any other trigger.

trigger.description: Trigger object. See also: get_started section "TOOL NOTES create_automation" for shapes. record_linked accepts direction:"link"|"unlink".

title: Create automation
